notes: 4.3 tells you sooner when the server refuses a channel: after about 3 seconds instead of 16, with far fewer requests to your account. If the refusal passes, the channel starts by itself. Problem reports now also say how each interruption ended, so freezes can be found and fixed. Your playlists and favourites stay.
notes_en: 4.3 tells you sooner when the server refuses a channel: after about 3 seconds instead of 16, with far fewer requests to your account. If the refusal passes, the channel starts by itself. Problem reports now also say how each interruption ended, so freezes can be found and fixed. Your playlists and favourites stay.
notes_sq: 4.3 të tregon më shpejt kur serveri e refuzon një kanal: pas rreth 3 sekondash në vend të 16, me shumë më pak kërkesa te llogaria jote. Nëse refuzimi kalon, kanali fillon vetë. Raportet e problemeve tash thonë edhe si përfundoi çdo ndërprerje, që ngrirjet të gjenden dhe të rregullohen. Playlist-at dhe favoritet e tua mbeten.
